product_wide_rationale: Owns Concord development coordination and its separation from planning, repository review, merge, and predecessor evidence. CD-0121 amends planning and issue linkage without changing those other boundaries.
summary: Concord owns its development workflow and supersedes the self-hosting prohibition. CD-0121 amends its planning and issue-linkage clauses; repository review and merge evidence retain their authority.
title: Concord development coordination
